global.title: Lavrov backs Iran in Tehran hours after Trump says Russia helps Tehran 'very little'
global.summary: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said in Tehran on Monday that Iran's cause, like Russia's, is 'just' and that Moscow will keep implementing economic and investment agreements with Iran. It came hours after US President Donald Trump defended easing sanctions on Russia, saying he wants Moscow to keep helping Iran only minimally while he negotiates an end to the Ukraine war.

global.title: Trump says Russia has been 'fine' on Ukraine as Moscow strikes Kyiv and energy sites
global.summary: Asked on Oct. 19 about Russia's conduct, US President Trump said Russia 'has been fine on Ukraine' and 'hasn't been doing much'. The remark came after Russia hit Kyiv with over a dozen ballistic missiles and targeted nearly 30 energy facilities across Ukraine, drawing sharp criticism from Ukrainian media.

global.title: Russian drone strike on park in Kharkiv Oblast kills six, including two children
global.summary: A Russian drone hit the central park of Nova Vodolaha in Kharkiv Oblast around 4:30 p.m. on Oct. 19 while families were present. Regional governor Oleh Syniehubov reported six dead, including girls aged eight and one, and at least 15 injured, seven of them children.

global.title: China's third-quarter growth quickens to 4.5% on export surge
global.summary: China's economy grew 4.5% year on year in July-September, beating the 4.4% economists expected and up from a three-year low of 4.3% in the second quarter. Strong overseas demand for tech goods offset a deepening property slump and weak consumer demand at home.

global.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh; Israel accuses Lebanese army over Hezbollah
global.summary: Saudi forces said on Tuesday they destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Iran-backed Houthi rebels from Yemen toward Riyadh, which has been repeatedly targeted for weeks, including airport attacks that killed 20 people earlier this month. Separately, the Israeli military accused the Lebanese army of working with Hezbollah, amid the wider US-Iran war.

zurich.title: Z?rcher Gesundheitsdirektorin Rickli bleibt im Regierungsrat
zurich.summary: Natalie Rickli (SVP) verzichtet auf eine Bundesratskandidatur und will im April 2027 wieder f?r den Z?rcher Regierungsrat kandidieren. Sie begr?ndet dies damit, dass der gr?sste Kanton eine stabile Regierung brauche, da nur drei von sieben Regierungsr?ten wieder antreten.

ai.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users' AI accounts
ai.summary: OpenCode, an open-source AI coding agent seen as an alternative to Claude Code and Cursor, said attackers broke into an older system, affecting 1.4% of users of its OpenCode Console where API keys are stored. The stolen keys were used to rack up unauthorized charges at AI providers.

movies.title: 'Street Fighter' opens to $31M as Elizabeth Holmes doc 'You Can See Everything' sells out
movies.summary: Paramount/Legendary/Capcom's video game adaptation 'Street Fighter' topped the US box office with about $31M, while 20th Century's $60M 'Whalefall' bombed with an $8M opening. A24's Elizabeth Holmes documentary 'You Can See Everything' drew over 2,000 sellouts.

movies.title: Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes documentary earns $15M from 855 theaters
movies.summary: 'You Can See Everything', directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, took second place with about $15M, far above the $7-8M forecast, a rare feat for a non-music documentary. It trailed only 'Street Fighter', which opened to roughly $30M from 3,575 venues.
